title: Golden Apple Enchantments
description: Adds several unique enchantments for golden apples. Transform your golden apples with powerful enchantments!
body:
Golden Apple Enchantments
Add a variety of unique enchantments to Golden Apples.

Mod Features
Enchantments
Infusing | Convert a regular Golden Apple into an Enchanted Golden Apple

Amplification | Increase the duration and level of potion effects from Enchanted Golden Apples

Energetic | Gain Strength, Speed, and Haste effects when eating an Enchanted Golden Apple

Glint | Gain Night Vision and Glowing effects when eating an Enchanted Golden Apple

Bountiful | Increase the hunger and saturation restored by Enchanted Golden Apples

Bane of Eden | Gain Hunger and Nausea effects when eating an Enchanted Golden Apple (Curse Enchantment)

Achievements
Gilded Radiance - Enchant a Golden Apple

Supreme Ruler - Eat an enchanted Golden Apple

Usage
Place the Golden Apple into the Enchanting Table and enchant it with Infusing to convert it into an Enchanted Golden Apple

The Enchanted Golden Apple can then be enchanted with other enchantments

Eat the enchanted Golden Apple and experience the unique effects!
